name: Sakuragawa Minato
source:
Mirai's twin brother, and the younger sibling.

Minato is quiet and pure-hearted, but gets teased a lot by his sister. His feminine appearance and cute honest character has made him very popular with the girls in his class. He holds Hiroaki in high regard.

[translated from Getchu]
